name: nueton-receipts
description: Counts every "done" your coding agent said and checks each one against the session's own commands: Confirmed, Contradicted or Unverified. Local, read-only, standard-library Python. Sends nothing.

interface.shortDescription: Check every "done" your agent said against its own logs
interface.longDescription: Runs the open-source Receipts collector over local Codex and Claude Code session logs, marks each completion claim Confirmed, Contradicted or Unverified from the session's own commands, and prints the counts plus a 40-column card. Read-only and offline; nothing is sent anywhere.
defaultPrompt: Show my receipts card for the last 30 days
How often was my agent's done actually true?
Audit my agent's completion claims since 2026-10-01 using local git history
